description: The first letter of an element's name says what it is. This simulator reads `R`, `C`, `L`, `K`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H`, `D`, `M`, `Q`, `V`, and `X`/`N` for an instance of a Verilog-A model or a subcircuit.
actions: For a device this simulator does not provide, write it as a Verilog-A model and instantiate it with an `X` line.
